ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Women, gender, and sexuality in Latin American literature and film." All seats reserved for Spanish major seniors during the early registration period. Non-registered students are not allowed to sit in or audit. (Taught in Spanish). Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes.
